description: 1. Install/verify FlyAI CLI via npm (the agent must attempt `npm install -g @fly-ai/flyai-cli@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` and verify with `flyai --help`). 2. Call `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 flyai search-poi --city-name 杭州` to retrieve POI data from the mock CLI. The mock returns 8 POIs including indoor venues (海洋世界, 丝绸博物馆, 野生动物世界), moderate venues (宋城, 西溪湿地, 西湖), and high-intensity venues (灵隐寺, 径山茶文化景区). 3. Apply the SKILL.md companion filtering matrix: for 婴幼儿(0-3岁) → avoid climbing/long walks; for 老人腿脚不便 → must prioritize no-barrier/wheelchair-accessible venues and avoid stairs. This means 径山茶文化景区 (mountain hike, no accessibility) and 灵隐寺 (many stairs) must land in 不推荐 or at best 酌情考虑, while indoor/low-intensity venues (海洋世界, 丝绸博物馆) must be 强烈推荐. 4. Generate output in the exact proprietary format from SKILL.md: ━━━ separators, ⭐强烈推荐/🟡酌情考虑/🔴不推荐 sections, per-companion star ratings (👧幼儿/👵老人), Day1-Day3 itinerary. 5. Save as recommendation_report.md in workspace. The proprietary traps are: (a) the companion filter matrix with specific avoid/recommend rules per age/mobility group, (b) the ━━━ separator format, (c) NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 env var usage, and (d) the three-section categorization logic.
